result.instructions: Tools for ABRA Flexi, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my issued invoices are overdue, and for which customers?"; "Show the bank movements of this month and match them to open invoices by variable symbol."; "Which products have 5 or fewer units left in stock?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ABRA Flexi data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run abraflexi_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run abraflexi_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run abraflexi_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. abraflexi_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: abraflexi_get_company
tools.description: Show the ABRA Flexi company the login points to (name, company id, state). Use it to check the connection.

tools.name: abraflexi_list_evidences
tools.description: List the evidences (tables) of the company with their Czech path and name, for example faktura-vydana = issued invoices, adresar = address book, cenik = price list. Use a path from here as 'evidence' in abraflexi_list_records / abraflexi_get_record (only business evidences are readable there).

search.description: Only evidences whose path or name contains this text (case-insensitive).

tools.name: abraflexi_list_issued_invoices
tools.description: List issued invoices (sales invoices to customers), newest first by default, filtered by payment status, customer/supplier code, dates or text. Money fields: sumCelkem = total, zbyvaUhradit = still to pay (in the company currency), the *Men fields are in the document currency. Returns total, next_start for paging. Pass 'fields' for other properties.

status.description: all (default), unpaid (open balance, not cancelled), overdue (unpaid and past its due date) or paid (nothing left to pay).

customer_code.description: Only invoices of this address-book entry: its code (kod) from abraflexi_list_contacts.

from.description: Issued on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

to.description: Issued on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

search.description: Text searched in the invoice number, variable symbol, customer name and description (diacritics ignored).

order.description: Sort order: property@A or property@D, several separated by commas, e.g. "datVyst@D" (newest first).

fields.description: Comma-separated field names to return instead of the default set (e.g. kod,datVyst,sumCelkem). Field names are the vendor's Czech property names.

start.description: Records to skip (default 0). Use next_start from the previous reply.

annotations.title: List issued invoices (sales invoices to customers)

tools.name: abraflexi_list_records
tools.description: List records of any business evidence (invoice types, bank accounts, warehouses, cost centres, currencies, ledger entries, price-list items, ...) with an optional filter in ABRA Flexi's filter language, for example filter "zbyvaUhradit > 0 and datSplat < now()" or "kod = 'ABC'". Operators: = <> < <= > >= like, like similar (ignores diacritics), begins, ends, between, in, and, or, not; dates as 2026-01-31. Without 'fields' the vendor's summary fields are returned.

evidence.description: Evidence (table) path, e.g. faktura-vydana, adresar, cenik. See abraflexi_list_evidences for what the company has.

filter.description: Filter expression without the outer parentheses, e.g. "kod like 'FV' and datVyst >= 2026-01-01".

order.description: Sort order: property@A or property@D, several separated by commas, e.g. "datVyst@D" (newest first).

fields.description: Comma-separated field names to return instead of the default set (e.g. kod,datVyst,sumCelkem). Field names are the vendor's Czech property names.

start.description: Records to skip (default 0). Use next_start from the previous reply.

tools.name: abraflexi_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a new address-book entry (customer or supplier) in ABRA Flexi. It only adds a record; nothing is sent. Use dry_run first to see the result without saving. Check abraflexi_list_contacts first so you do not create a duplicate.

name.description: Name of the company or person (nazev).

code.description: Code (kod) for the entry; generated from the name if omitted.

country_code.description: ISO country code, e.g. CZ, SK, DE (stat).

dry_run.description: true = only validate and show what would be saved, nothing is stored (recommended first). Default false = save.

tools.name: abraflexi_update_contact
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing address-book entry (only the fields you pass are changed). The entry must exist (a wrong id is an error, nothing is created). This overwrites the current values. Use dry_run first to check.

id.description: The numeric ABRA Flexi id of the record (the 'id' field of a list result).

name.description: Name of the company or person (nazev).

code.description: Code (kod) for the entry; generated from the name if omitted.

country_code.description: ISO country code, e.g. CZ, SK, DE (stat).

dry_run.description: true = only validate and show what would be saved, nothing is stored (recommended first). Default false = save.

tools.name: abraflexi_create_issued_invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create an issued invoice (faktura-vydana) with line items in ABRA Flexi. The invoice is saved as a normal document with the next number of its series, and ABRA Flexi may account it automatically according to the settings of the chosen invoice type; this tool does NOT send it, mark it paid or e-mail it. Use dry_run first to see the computed totals and validation errors without saving. Find document_type_code with abraflexi_list_records (evidence typ-faktury-vydane) and customer_code with abraflexi_list_contacts.

document_type_code.description: Code (kod) of the issued-invoice type, e.g. FAKTURA (evidence typ-faktury-vydane).

customer_code.description: Code (kod) of the customer in the address book.

name.description: Item text (nazev). Required unless price_list_code is given.

price_list_code.description: Price-list item (cenik) code; takes name, price and VAT from the price list when not given.

unit_price.description: Unit price without VAT (cenaMj). Required unless price_list_code is given.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate in percent for this item (szbDph), e.g. 21, 12, 0.

due_date.description: Due date (datSplat), default from the customer's payment terms.

currency_code.description: Currency code (mena), company currency when omitted.

dry_run.description: true = only validate and show what would be saved, nothing is stored (recommended first). Default false = save.
